name: Hans-Peter Streiff
bio:
Hans-Peter's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the intricate clockwork mechanisms of Swiss watches, which naturally evolved into an appreciation for the precision engineering of racing cars. After obtaining a degree in mechanical engineering from ETH Zurich, he cut his teeth in Formula 3, developing race strategies for a small privateer team. His analytical mind and ability to anticipate track conditions quickly earned him a reputation as a rising star.

He is known for his data-driven approach, meticulously analyzing telemetry and weather patterns to craft race strategies that exploit every possible advantage. His distinctive ability lies in balancing calculated risk-taking with a pragmatic understanding of long-term championship goals. Hans-Peter's unflappable demeanor under pressure makes him a valuable asset on the pit wall, providing calm and decisive guidance to the team.

physical.description: A man of medium height with a wiry build and intense, focused eyes.

quirks: Always carries a well-worn slide rule, even though he also uses sophisticated software.
Insists on having a specific brand of Swiss chocolate available in the pit garage during races.
Has a habit of muttering calculations to himself while staring intensely at the track.
